Select exact IC50 activity rows for human PDE4B (CHEMBL275). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN to require SMILES. Join docs on doc_id to capture publication provenance. Join compound_records on record_id with a LEFT JOIN to retrieve compound_key. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL275 and standard_type IC50. Keep all rows without deduplication. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
